newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice sets new contract highs on cash, specs.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice sets new contract highs on cash, specs.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed higher and new contract highs were set with firm cash prices for high quality rice again cited as a bullish influence, traders said.
"There's the ongoing same fundamentals and the volumes are larger," a trader said.
Traders said speculative interest in the market was increasing.
"There is rising volume now and rising open interest," the trader said.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 500 contracts, above the 463 traded Tuesday, according to the CBOT.
The new high for January was $11.15 per cwt, up from the previous high of $11.05 per cwt set Tuesday.
Rice closed nine to 10 cents per cwt higher, with January up 10 at $11.15 per cwt.
